assets.prompt: The mother rabbit smiles warmly as her three little rabbit children happily share carrots and cuddle close. The smallest bunny giggles, the other bunny looks lovingly at its mother, and the third bunny gently hops closer. Their ears move naturally. Flowers sway softly in the breeze. Warm sunlight flickers through the garden. The camera slowly moves forward toward the family. Gentle, natural animation, smooth cinematic camera movement, preserve the exact character appearance, clothing, colors and faces from the reference image. No scene changes, no sudden movements, no text.
